end.summary:
Explored “unity in diversity” and “many in the one” using songs, festivals, languages and food.
Gave examples including Diwali, Pongal, Bihu, Lohri, phiran and mundu.
Explained that sharing different languages, foods and celebrations can bring people together.
Identified that treating only one’s own festival as best can cause problems.
Teach-back was not completed; the lesson ended after a short break.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining how differences in language, food, dress and festivals can enrich society, using familiar examples and a comparison with different songs. They correctly identified several regional examples and later changed “weird” to “different” when discussing Pongal, though they still described it as feeling unfamiliar. At home, invite Riya to choose two festivals or foods from different regions and explain one similarity and one difference.
